decode.title: Decode benchmark
decode.modelHint: Select which model the benchmark targets.
decode.noModels: No models are currently served by this target.
decode.thinkingHint: On by default. Reasoning tokens count toward decode tok/s.
decode.concurrencyHint: Levels run sequentially; each opens that many parallel streams.
decode.emptyBody: Pick a prompt type and concurrency levels, then run. Each level opens that many parallel streams and reports aggregate and per-stream decode tok/s.
decode.errorModel: Select a currently served model before running the benchmark
decode.errorConcurrency: Select at least one concurrency level
decode.errorMaxTokens: Max tokens must be an integer between 64 and 2048
decode.errorTemperature: Temperature must be a number between 0 and 2
decode.temperatureHint: Default 0.7 · 0 is greedy · 0 to 2. Before v2.70 the bench always ran at temp 0 with thinking off: set 0 to compare with those runs. Temp above 0 can be much slower on servers that use speculative decoding.
decode.contextHint: Each stream is prefilled to this many tokens first, then decodes from there. Needs prefix caching and KV room for concurrency × context.
decode.legend: Aggregate — total decode tok/s across all concurrent streams. Stream — per-stream average decode.
decode.mixedHistory: These runs use different temperature or thinking settings. Compare tok/s only between runs with the same settings; temp above 0 can be several times slower.

prefill.title: Prefill benchmark
prefill.contextHint: Type a custom token count to add it.
prefill.legend: Prefill — the server's own prompt-processing timing when it reports one, otherwise tokens computed ÷ (TTFT − calibrated request overhead), with prefix-cache hits excluded and the correction capped at half the TTFT. TTFT — request start to first streamed token. Tokens, TTFT and tok/s are from the median-rate sample of each size. Each size uses a unique prefix so prefix-cache does not inflate later sizes. Low confidence — the overhead was over 30% of the TTFT, so the rate leans on the calibration; n/m samples — some repeats failed.
prefill.emptyBody: Choose the context sizes to test, then run. Each size sends a unique prompt and reports prefill tok/s and time to first token.

quality.title: Quality benchmark
quality.concurrencyTitle: How many questions are sent to the model at the same time
quality.noSharedItems: No shared items between these runs.
quality.label: Label
quality.sameItems: Both runs passed and failed the same items.
quality.suiteHint: Fixed, seeded suite at temperature 0 — the same items every run, so runs pair item by item.
quality.example: Example (the shape of the real prompts)
quality.skippedLong: Skipped long sizes above the model context: {{sizes}}
quality.legend: Score — items passed. p — exact McNemar test on items only one run got right; p ≥ 0.05 means the difference is within noise. Items with a request error or timeout are not scored and are left out of the comparison.
quality.emptyBody: Pick the categories to score, give the run a label (for example the quantisation or KV-cache format) and run. The suite is fixed and seeded, so any two runs can be compared item by item.
